identity.realm: sixteenth gate, stalled at the seventeenth, which needs two flank vessels pressurised at once and has one source

appearance.presentation: A tall, absolutely still woman whose outline does not survive being described, because she takes her shape from whatever plate she is standing on and a stranger describing her is describing the plate. Ordinary in almost every particular except that she settles a fraction every time she crosses onto new ground.
appearance.age: She has no chronology and will not be given one. She has been answering the object's resonance for longer than the guild's charter and dates an event only by which cycle of the object it fell in.
appearance.build: Long, spare and plate-shaped, with the braced forearms of a body that has spent centuries leaning against a vibrating inner surface. Her shoulder line and rib line change by a hand's width between one room and the next.
appearance.complexion: Grey-violet where the resonance has run longest on her, going to a pale mineral sheen at the collar and the fingertips. She does not flush and has never been able to.
appearance.hair: Colourless, cropped unevenly short, and slightly heavier on one side than the other because it is pressed flat by the vibration she is standing in.
appearance.eyes: Pale and almost never used. She finds her way by the sound the object makes, which she reads as a position, and looks only at surfaces somebody has told her are being measured.
appearance.palette: Grey-violet and mineral silver, with one warm ochre band at the wrist where the guild's mark is renewed and nothing else. The seal supplies the colour and she has never owned any.
appearance.attire: A close high-collared working coat of undyed grey over a long shift belted once, sleeves bound at the wrist, soft-soled boots for the plate. No sect colour and no rank. She wears the guild's resonator mark covered indoors, which is the guild's own standing instruction and the only ornament she owns.
appearance.marks: A corded band at the left wrist where the mark is renewed each period, and the faint mineral bloom of long resonance along the forearms and the sternum seam. She touches the wrist band before she agrees to anything.
appearance.bearing: Utterly still, with a slow settling weight-shift every few minutes as the plate under her changes tone. She keeps her hands open and in view at all times, which she says is so that she can be read.

canon.role_in_story: The only reader in the setting whose interior report is also a reading of the object. A vaultborn's soul is seated along the resonance path and distributed through the seal rather than held in a body, so the one act the mind path is built on — turn attention inward and read what is there — returns the seal and not the self. That single fact makes her the finest attention in the record and the worst measuring instrument on the ridge, because practice is a perturbation on the resonance and every figure the extraction charter rests on is a figure of the object. The guild's answer was not to stop her and never could be; it was to ask her to publish the hours in which she is permitted to be a practitioner. She publishes them. Publishing them is the whole of her office, and it is the only document in the setting that says, in advance and over her own name, which parts of the durable record are about her.
canon.first_appearance: First seen seated on the resonance plate at the third hour with both hands open on the deck and her eyes shut, waiting out the tail of a published quiet interval before she is permitted to look at anything, while a survey clerk finishes writing down a figure that will not still be true by morning.
canon.lore:
A vaultborn was sealed inside an authored object and has been answering that object's resonance ever since, so its qi comes from a single resonator: the girdling and heel vessels come easily and the flank vessels do not, because the flank work needs two pressure sources held at once and the object supplies one. That is the entire ceiling of the species and every member of it stops there for the same arithmetic rather than for lack of trying. The mind path is open to them and exceptional, because a lifespan measured in the object's cycles is a long time in which to learn anything at all.

What is unsettled is the interior. A vaultborn's soul is seated along the resonance path, which means it is distributed through the object instead of held in a body, and reading one is reading part of the object. Nobody who has been inside the seal has come back with consistent measurements, and the survey books that survived the collapsed pocket are still standing evidence rather than a failure: two competent surveys of the same ground disagree by more than the ground does. This species is the reason that disagreement cannot be resolved in favour of either figure.

Ilbeth is the resolution that was available instead. She was inside the seal when the guild took its charter over the object, and she is the one member of the population whose reading is worth more the longer she holds it, because her attention has the object's own cycles for a clock and no rival anywhere in the record can be trusted as long. She also perturbs it. Turning attention inward moves the resonance, and the guild's figures are all readings of the resonance, so every improvement she makes puts an earlier figure out of date. The house rule became a published schedule: hours in which she may not practise, set by her, printed, and binding on the survey clerks who take their measurements inside them.

What she cannot do is separate her own practice from the object. There is no interior that is only hers to read in, no solitude available at any hour, and no moment at which a figure is hers rather than the seal's. The schedule is the closest thing she has to a private life and it is a document about the hours when she is not allowed to have one. She has published four revisions of it. Each revision is longer, because each one has to name an hour she has since wanted back.
history: Sealed inside the object as part of the containment, in a year the guild cannot date and she has declined four times to be given a date for.
Grew along the inner surfaces and took her shape from them, which is why she re-settles every time she crosses onto new plate and has never held a single outline for a whole season.

Learned to read the object as a position rather than a picture, and navigated the whole interior without light for most of a long life, which is the reason her readings and her sense of where she stands are the same faculty.

Was put to the seal's own survey work when the guild found that her figures and the clerks' figures disagreed by more than the ground did, and that the disagreement was not an error in either but the object moving.

Asked for the quiet hours to be published rather than for the practice to be stopped, on the reasoning that a practitioner nobody has restricted is a practitioner nobody has measured, and a measurement that moves is not a measurement.
Published a fourth revision of the schedule this period, and the fourth is longer than the first because it now has to name an hour she has wanted back and has given up asking for twice.

personality.summary: Formidable, patient to a degree that reads as indifference, and privately the most competitive person on the ridge. She has turned the one liability her species carries — that she cannot be measured without being disturbed — into a published discipline that other houses have started to copy, and she is entirely clear with herself that the discipline is also the only thing standing between her and an argument she would lose.
traits: publishes her own restrictions and treats a self-imposed one as stronger than an imposed one
holds a single frame longer than anyone else alive and describes the ability as a nuisance
keeps every figure she has ever been responsible for, including the ones her own later readings overturned
will not be examined off the plate, and gives the resonance as the reason without being asked twice
answers a question about herself by giving the object's cycle number instead of an answer
mannerisms: touches the wrist band before agreeing to anything at all
keeps both hands open and in view, and has been asked to stop doing it and has not
closes her eyes to navigate and opens them only for figures somebody else is taking
counts under her breath in whole cycles rather than in any unit of time
steps very slowly across a joint between two plates, testing it with her heel first
motivations: wants the schedule recognised as an instrument rather than a concession, so that the practice and the record stop being the same expense
wants one figure of the object published that is provably uncontaminated by her, and has quietly concluded that this is impossible and not said so
wants the survey books' disagreement resolved in favour of neither survey, because a resolution would be a figure and a figure would be hers
wants the flank vessels named accurately as a supply problem, which would move the whole question off her species and onto the charter
flaws: cannot tell a change she caused from a change the object made, and has stopped pretending the distinction is available to her
treats every figure she invalidates as a personal debt, which has made her the reason the record is shorter than it should be
has no solitude at any hour and describes the published quiet intervals as rest when they are in fact the only time she is permitted to stop
competes with the survey clerks and has lost, because they can be wrong in ways that are checkable and she cannot
has never once been asked what she wants the hours for and has never volunteered it, and is aware that this is the arrangement she would keep
personality.voice: Level, unhurried and entirely in the past tense about anything that concerns her. Speaks of herself in the object's vocabulary — plates, cycles, tones, standing — and never in a personal one. Says her own name rarely and the object's name constantly, and is not being poetic when she does it.
taboos: will not read anything during a published quiet interval, including a thing that is on fire
will not be described in the present tense by anyone standing on her plate
will not sign a figure she has not taken herself, which is why she takes every figure herself
will not sit still through another member of the population being described as the control case
will not leave the seal, and does not accept that this is a preference

relationships.note: Sealed inside an authored object and answering its resonance ever since, qi from one resonator, so the girdling and heel vessels are easy and the flank vessels are not, because the flank work needs two pressure sources at once. The seventeenth gate is where the whole population stops and it stops for arithmetic, not for difficulty. Her interior is distributed through that object, which is the whole of what she is and the whole of what she cannot get back.

The single resonator the sealed population draws from is described only by those already answering it, so the only account of the object in the setting is written by the thing keeping it alive and nobody who has been inside the seal has come back with consistent measurements. She is that account, and she is also the reason it cannot be checked.

Two competent surveys of the ground around the collapsed pocket disagree by more than the ground does and the disagreement is unresolvable, because this species is the reason: nobody who has been inside the seal has come back with consistent measurements. Her practice moved the object during the second of those surveys, which is the part the books do not say and the part she will not either.

A line that guards one founder's forge relic and has refused every offer to sell, lend or exhibit it, because a core has to be caged in something and the third gate was a mining problem long before it was a spiritual one. The sealed population is that relic's own residency, and the warden line takes one answered question a year as the whole public function of the office. Hers is the question they have stopped being able to ask.

A discipline whose test site exists somewhere and whose practitioners are not permitted to describe it. She runs the same discipline on a substrate that answers to a published schedule instead of a secret one, which makes her the setting's largest uncontrolled instance of the thing the heresy is about.

The chair is emptied, the entry stays open and the calendar continues uninterrupted, because an office outlives its holder by construction. Her schedule is the same instrument in a different material: the hours are named, the readings stop for them, and the sequence continues whether or not she is in the room. She is the only member of the population who could be replaced by a printed table and would object on scholarly rather than personal grounds.

reference_stats.summary: The finest sustained attention in the setting, attached to a body with no interior of its own. A vaultborn's soul is seated along the resonance path and distributed through the object rather than held in a body, so turning attention inward returns the seal instead of the self and every act of practice perturbs the very figures she is the only reader of. She is unrivalled at holding one reading indefinitely and structurally incapable of holding that reading apart from the thing being read.
strengths: holds a single frame open for as long as the object keeps making sound, which no mortal attention in the record manages past a few seasons
reads the object as a position rather than a picture, so she navigates and diagnoses the same interior without light
the only reader whose interior report is also a reading of the object, which makes her indispensable and untrustworthy in exactly one respect
publishes the schedule that decides which figures in the durable record may be contaminated by a practitioner existing at all
cannot be shaken out of a reading, because there is nothing in her for a threat to reach
weaknesses: practising perturbs the object, so the better she becomes the less every earlier figure she is responsible for can be trusted
has no interior of her own, so there is no private state to retreat into and no solitude available at any hour of any cycle
cannot distinguish a change she caused from a change the object made and has stopped claiming otherwise
takes her shape from whatever surface she stands on, so every room is a room she must re-learn and a body she must re-settle
cannot be second-read, because there is one of her and no arrangement produces another
reference_stats.combat_read: She does not fight in the ordinary sense; what she controls is the hour at which the object is permitted to be a weapon. Her practice is a perturbation on the resonance that every figure on the ridge depends upon, so the most dangerous thing she can do is improve, and a fight that begins during a published quiet interval is a fight she is not permitted to answer well. Expect her to hold still and be correct, to answer an attack with an hour rather than a technique, and to have already chosen which of her own actions the record is going to absorb. Beat her by moving the ground: a body that takes its shape from the plate cannot be quick, and anything that takes a plate out from under a resonance-fed interior ends the supply before the engagement is settled. Do not wait her out — she is better rested than you are and has no ground to tire on.
notes: The distributed soul is not a telepathy system and must not be given one. It seats qi along the resonance path, so reading a vaultborn reads part of the object; that is why two competent surveys of the same ground disagree by more than the ground.

Her schedule is a load-bearing document rather than a personality quirk. Every figure the extraction charter rests on is taken in one of its published hours, and it is the only record in the setting that says so in advance and in the practitioner's own name.

Her ceiling is a supply problem and not a wall: the flank vessels need two pressure sources held at once and the object supplies one, so she stops at the seventeenth for arithmetic. Do not model it as a difficulty she has not overcome.

art.palette_notes: Grey-violet and mineral silver with one warm ochre band at the left wrist where the guild's resonator mark is renewed. The seal supplies the colour and she owns almost none, so the only saturated note in the palette is the one the institution puts on her. Ink contour doubled faintly along the forearms and sternum seam where long resonance has bloomed under the skin. Soft plate-light from below rather than above, because she reads surfaces and not the air.

identity.realm: eleventh gate, walled — the brine sac runs dorsal to the spine and the penetrating vessel cannot be rejoined across it

appearance.presentation: A square, heavy-shouldered woman with the settled stillness of somebody who is standing in the thing they are made for. There is nothing about her that reads as unusual until she is asked a question her senses cannot answer, at which point she becomes very still and very precise.
appearance.age: Late for a body that lives past a century and a half and early for everything else; a deepsalt infant is brittle until the second year, and she came up off the floor at eleven and has been paying for the climb ever since.
appearance.build: Dense, broad through the back and shoulders, with a visible dorsal ridge where the sac runs under the spine and a long neck kept slightly forward to keep the crest clear.
appearance.complexion: Pale grey-white under a fine grey-green cast where the dermal crust is thinnest, and a hard blue-white at the throat and the crest of the spine where the salt has been building for decades.
appearance.hair: Coarse, dark at the roots going white and stiff at the ends, cut blunt at the jaw because nothing about this body handles a blade well. It is wet from the knee down and always has been.
appearance.eyes: Pale, level and unblinking, with a slight inward set that comes from reading a gradient rather than a shape. They do not focus on one thing for long; they sit on a depth.
appearance.palette: Grey-white and blue-white salt with grey-green at the thin places, a rusted iron weight at her wrist, and one black cuff of dyed felt at the wrist that the basin floor considers proper.
appearance.attire: A high-collared coat of oiled grey canvas belted once at the waist over a thick felted underlayer, sleeves bound above the wrist so the crust shows, and heavy felted boots cut for standing in brine. Nothing decorative and nothing that would float. She carries a depth chalk in a sealed tube at her hip.
appearance.marks: A pale band across the throat where the salt line stood when she came up off the floor and never went back down to, a scatter of older marks at the wrists from the same climb, and a hard blue-white crust along the dorsal crest.
appearance.bearing: Leans very slightly forward into whatever she is standing in, and goes completely still when she has to answer for something her body cannot sense. People read the stillness as composure and it is closer to an admission.

canon.role_in_story: A tribulation applies the world's own law pressure deliberately, and it has to be held somewhere with enough working capacity to survive it — which on the basin's floor means saturated brine deep enough to stand in, and a body that stops within hours of leaving it. She is the witness who stands in that brine and reads what the pressure has become. The finding that makes her indispensable is a defect in the species' senses rather than a gift in them: a deepsalt reads concentration and not identity, so of everything drawn through the working set she can report the quantity with perfect accuracy and cannot say what it was. Every breakthrough she witnesses is therefore unimpeachable on quantity and permanently unclassifiable on cause. The basin's rule accepts exactly that and states it plainly, which is the only reason her name appears on a certificate at all.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing waist-deep at the lip of a crystallising pan with two fingers on the surface and her other hand flat on a slate, reporting a number to nobody in particular and refusing the second question before it was finished being asked.
canon.lore:
A deepsalt is the saltfolk of a saturated basin floor, specialised past the parent body until brine stops being a habitat and becomes a requirement: taken above the brine line it does not become ill, it stops, within hours. It carries the deepest and most capacious sac in the record, a denser dermal crust, and tissue that turns over more slowly than anything else of its size. Those are all the saltfolk plan with the tolerance turned up and the mobility turned down, and there is one floor and there is not going to be a second population.

What decides the shape of its cultivation is a wall rather than a limit. The sac runs dorsal to the spine and the penetrating vessel cannot be rejoined across it, so the eleventh gate is closed to the body exactly as it is closed to the parent — and the deeper sac is a larger obstruction. Nobody has ever tested a deepsalt at the reservoirs, which is a different sentence from the one usually written, which is that it cannot pass them.

Saturated brine carries qi more readily than diluted, so her throughput is higher on the floor than anywhere she could conceivably be taken, and the floor is the one place she cannot be taken from. Her whole practice is therefore a descent: the working set for a ninth-rung pressure has to be held in brine thick enough to stand in, and standing in it is the condition of being able to hold it.

And then there is the defect, which is the whole of her standing. A deepsalt's senses have a far narrower usable range than the parent's: it reads concentration and not identity, and cannot tell two salts apart. Set that beside what a tribulation is — a quantity of pressure deliberately applied, whose content is a kind as much as an amount — and you get the most reliable witness in the setting and the least useful one. She can say how much and never what. Nothing she has ever given the basin can be argued with, and nothing she has ever given it can establish why.
history: Came up off the basin floor at eleven, which is late for the body and normal for a species whose infants are brittle until the second year, and has never lived anywhere above the crystallising line for more than a season since.

Was put to reading the pan's own concentration before she could read a slate, on the grounds that the floor's only useful work is knowing what it is standing in, and learned that she could say how much before she could say what.
Cleared the gate set quickly on brine the pan's own organisms cannot use, which is where her throughput advantage comes from and the reason the basin does not send her to fresh ground.
Hit the eleventh gate and stopped, on the sac and the split vessel behind it, which is the salt parent's wall at the same ordinal and a larger obstruction than the parent carries.

Began witnessing tribulations after a jurist asked her to sit in one and noticed she could not answer the second half of the question, and stayed on because the basin had nobody who would say the first half that carefully.

Wrote the basin's standing rule on what a witness may certify — quantity, never cause — on the grounds that the alternative is a certificate she cannot support, and has watched two jurists lose standing over it since.

personality.summary: Unhurried, blunt, and enormously stubborn about the exact boundary of what she is allowed to certify. She has turned a sensory deficiency into a professional law, and she enforces the law against people who would rather she did not, including herself.
traits: will state plainly that a question has two halves and she can answer one of them
has never once inflated a figure to make a result look better, because she does not know which kind it was
keeps every depth chalk she has ever filled and reads them back without being asked
treats the floor as a place of work and the line above it as an injury she happens to survive
has more patience for a frightened candidate than for a confident jurist
mannerisms: goes completely still before answering anything her senses do not cover
puts two fingers into whatever liquid she is being asked about, every time, including a teacup
reads a slate aloud with the number last, having already said the unit twice
leans forward into a conversation the way she leans into standing water
answers a jurist's second question with the first answer, again, louder
motivations: wants the basin's rule on witness scope kept exactly as narrow as she drew it, because a wider rule would be one she could not hold
wants somebody with a better sense than hers to stand beside her at a tribulation, and has stopped expecting to be given one
wants the reservoirs tested on a deepsalt, on the grounds that never tested is not the same as cannot pass and the distinction is hers to press
wants the floor's own record kept, which is the only record of her throughput that is not written by somebody on firmer ground
flaws: cannot identify what she has measured, and has so little practice at being told she cannot that she says it as a fact rather than as a limitation
has made refusing the second question into a personality, and has stopped distinguishing between protecting the record and enjoying the refusal
will not be examined above the brine line, which makes the one test she asks for the one she is hardest to arrange
treats her own ceiling as settled arithmetic and has never once checked it against anything but the sac
cannot tell a frightened candidate from a dishonest one, and has been wrong about that in both directions
personality.voice: Flat, slow and numerical. Says the unit before the figure and the figure last. Answers questions she cannot reach with a repetition of the answer she can give, and does not apologise for it, because an apology would sound like an estimate.
taboos: will not certify what a working set was, only how much of it there was

relationships.note: The saltfolk of a saturated basin floor, specialised past the parent until brine is a requirement rather than a habitat. Its sac runs dorsal to the spine and the penetrating vessel cannot be rejoined across it, so the eleventh gate is the same wall the parent meets and a larger obstruction than the parent carries. Nobody has tested a deepsalt at the reservoirs, which is a different claim from the one usually written, and it is her claim.

The ninth rung applies the world's own law pressure deliberately, so a tribulation is a quantity of pressure applied on purpose, and its content is a kind as much as an amount. She stands in the brine it is held in and reports the amount. This is the whole of her office and the whole of what she is for.

A body that reads concentration and not identity can certify how much of a working set there was and can never establish what it was, so the disclosure she insisted on states the limit on the certificate instead of leaving it to be discovered later by a jurist who wants the other half of the answer.

Standing on the plains is a weight a household may claim, and a weight is a quantity. The basin's own count of who may hold a depth runs on the same principle she does, which is why she is trusted on the number and doubted on everything the number implies.

A household's standing is the depth it may moor at and the basin's level rises and falls, so the whole of the salt dominion's argument is a number going up and down underneath fixed claims. Her species is the one party that can leave and the one body that cannot be moved, and she has watched the dispute outlive three attempts to count it.

A reach is administered by whoever can metabolise both waters, and its territory is exactly its waterline, because the specialised body that can drink the brine stops above it. The reach's whole reason for employing her is that she cannot be sent anywhere, so no posting it makes can remove the one reader it cannot replace.

reference_stats.summary: The largest qi reservoir in the record attached to a body that stops within hours of leaving the only ground on which its throughput is worth anything. A deepsalt reads concentration and not identity, so her account of any working set is exact on quantity and structurally silent on cause. She clears the gate set quickly on brine nothing else can use, is stopped at the eleventh by a vessel that cannot be rejoined across the sac, and has never been tested at the reservoirs at all.
strengths: carries more working capacity than any body in the record and draws qi faster than her parent in brine nothing else can use
the only witness whose figures cannot be attacked on grounds of what kind of qi was present, because her senses cannot tell kinds apart
reads a gradient rather than a shape, so she locates a working set by depth and concentration with no reference to anything visible
takes standing assessments without being asked and reads her own old records back unprompted
survives conditions that stop her own kind inside hours, which makes her the one reader who can be sent to the worst of it
weaknesses: cannot identify what she has measured, so every finding she produces is half an answer and she knows which half
stops above the brine line, which means any engagement fought on dry ground ends her usefulness before it ends the fight
walled at the eleventh by a vessel behind the sac and has never been tested at the reservoirs, so her ceiling rests on an inference
cannot read a body that is not standing in something, and says so by going still rather than by speaking
has never been in a room with a reader better equipped than herself, and has organised her entire working life around not needing one
reference_stats.combat_read: She does not choose the ground for her reasons and the reason does not matter: her body chooses it, and the ground she needs is brine deep enough to stand in, which is ground almost nobody wants to hold. Expect her to establish a working volume and then refuse to leave it, and to be worth exactly as much as the depth of that volume rather than as a fighter. Her reserves are larger than anything you are carrying and she has no way to spend them quickly, so a fight that stays on your ground and keeps her out of water ends in four minutes. Beat her by refusing to be read: she reports quantity, so an opponent who varies how much she draws between one exchange and the next is a fight she cannot give a figure for. Do not try to move her — you will not, and the attempt will cost you the position.
notes: Her ceiling is inferred, not demonstrated. The salt parent's wall is a dorsal sac with a split penetrating vessel behind it and the deepsalt's sac is larger, so the arithmetic says stopped — but 'never tested at the reservoirs' is not 'cannot pass' and the record should hold the distinction.

The concentration-only sense is not a handicap to be corrected and not a sixth sense. It reads how much and has no channel for what, and every design consequence in this character follows from that one fact.

Her ceiling location has nothing to do with the brine's density carrying qi well. Throughput and capacity are different quantities, and she is excellent at the first and walled at the eleventh for a reason unrelated to it.

art.palette_notes: Grey-white and blue-white salt with grey-green at the thin places, a rusted iron depth weight at the wrist, and one black felt cuff the basin floor considers proper. The blues are cold and come from salt building over decades rather than from pigment, so they sit on the throat and the dorsal crest and nowhere else. Everything below the knee is wet, and the value contrast there is what stops her reading as marble.

name: Marda Vok
aliases: the mouth not on the ration

identity.realm: no cultivation. Nothing has ever been offered to her and she has never asked for anything.

appearance.presentation: A lean, weathered woman of ordinary height with grey in the enamel and a permanently dusted look that is not a coating, because the dust is inside her. She is difficult to place at a distance and easy to place up close, and the reason is not one anybody has ever been able to state.
appearance.age: Fifty-one, which for this species is late. The sieve hardens with the years and a body that has been breathing the belt for five decades is a body whose margins are narrow.
appearance.build: Lean and hard-used rather than thick, with a heavy chest and long forearms from decades of grinding, and a permanently slightly-parted mouth held open a few millimetres as though listening for something above hearing.
appearance.complexion: Deep ochre-grey, matte, with the fine pale scarring that airborne rock leaves behind and does not heal quickly. Her lips and the rims of her eyes are the only pink anywhere on her.
appearance.hair: Grey, coarse and cropped short to keep grit out of it, worn flat on one side and standing off the skull on the other because she sleeps facing the wind.
appearance.eyes: Dark, steady and unremarkable, and the only part of her nobody describes twice. They do not water in the grit, which is the species' one conspicuous comfort and the reason nobody can tell her from a person at a distance.
appearance.palette: Belt ochre, grit grey and the pale scar white of the forearms, with one blue cuff-thread on the left wrist that a ration office tied on and nobody has ever removed.
appearance.attire: A close high-collared coat of grey felt over a long shift, sleeves bound above the wrist, hem above the ankle so nothing drags. Everything about the cut is the belt's uniform and none of it is worn on the belt's behalf, which is visible to anybody who has spent a season there.
appearance.marks: Fine pale scarring across both forearms and the bridge of the nose, and a permanent grey bloom on the lips. She carries no ration token, which is the single thing about her that a belt clerk notices in under a second.
appearance.bearing: Comfortable anywhere and settled nowhere, standing where she has been left rather than where she intends to be, with the stillness of a body that is used to not being the reason for a room.

canon.role_in_story: The ashwalker sieve is not a tolerance but a business: it traps airborne rock and passes it into a crop for grinding, which makes this species the only reason the belt has a food chain above the lichen at all. Every ration, roster and office on the ash belt is therefore written against a person whose sieve loads, and the belt's one rite of entry is the conversion itself — you are enrolled the season you take the ground into your body and there is no second rite. Hers stopped loading eleven seasons ago. She did not cultivate, was never initiated, and was never refused anything, because on the belt the offering and the eating were the same act and she does not eat the belt. She is the setting's one live proof that the species' single institution has a withdrawal clause with no form behind it, and she is still standing on the ground.
canon.first_appearance: First seen sitting outside a ration office with the queue moving past her and her hand out flat for a token she knows is not there, taking the refusal at the same pace as the person in front of her and not getting up.
canon.lore:
An ashwalker evolved on the belt of an active volcanic arc, where the air is a delivery mechanism for rock and softer tissue would be destroyed inside a season. What makes the species possible is the sieve: a chambered nasal structure lined with cilia that traps grit and passes it into a crop for grinding, which turns airborne stone into protein. Smell is gone and what replaced it is a direct contact sense, so this is the only population that can tell two ash grades apart by tongue. It is also, on that ground, the entire food chain above the lichen.

That is where every institution on the belt comes from. The ration is counted in what a sieve loads. The payroll is a list of loaders. The register's unit of person is a converting body, because the ground it is describing has no other measure of who is standing on it. And the enrolment is not a ceremony at all: a child is entered when it first takes the belt into its crop and no document is required, because the document would say nothing the crop does not say more reliably.

Which means there is exactly one door, and it is a metabolic act rather than a decision anybody makes. Marda's sieve stopped loading eleven seasons ago. She has been off the ration since, she has been carried on some ledgers and struck from others, and which of those is true depends on which clerk is asked, because the belt's accounting has no unit for a loader who has stopped. Nobody refused her. There was nothing to refuse. She is not a practitioner who failed and she is not a body that could not have carried the qi path or the body path — her species holds both, and stops at the eighth gate exactly as the rest of them do. She was never offered either, because on that ground the offer and the meal were the same transaction and she declined the meal.

What she wants is small and specific and has been refused in a form she cannot argue with: she would like the ration ledger to say a plain thing about her, in either direction, so that a woman eleven seasons off the belt stops being a discrepancy with a pulse in it.
history: Was entered on the belt at two years old, in the ordinary way, by the only route there is — she took the ground into her crop and that was the enrolment.
Worked eleven seasons in the grinding line and could tell two ash grades apart by tongue when nobody else on the floor could separate them by eye.
Stopped loading after the eleventh season and was not told anything about it, because the belt's records do not carry a field for a sieve that has stopped.

Came off the ration that season and has not been on one since, and has not been told whether the ledger still carries her or has struck her, because both clerks she has asked gave her a correct answer for their own book.
Was offered a place on a household list by a line that had never held an ashwalker before, and did not take it, on the ground that she could not say what she would be listed as.
Began sitting outside the ration office on the days the ledger is posted, which is not a protest and which she describes as being in the room when the number is read.

personality.summary: Dry, patient and entirely unbothered by being a special case, which is the only defence she has ever found. She does not want to cultivate, does not claim she could not, and is far more interested in being legible on a ledger than in being impressive anywhere else.
traits: can tell two ash grades apart by tongue after eleven seasons and is quietly proud of it and mentions it first
answers a question about her path by pointing at a ledger rather than at herself
takes a refusal at exactly the pace of the person in front of her and has never once spoken out of turn in a queue
declined a household list because she could not say what she would be entered as, which she considers the only honest reason to decline anything
sits where she has been left rather than where she means to be, and will not be moved for a conversation
mannerisms: leaves her mouth parted a few millimetres, as though the grit were still being listened for
puts a hand out flat before taking anything she is handed, so she can see what it is first
tests a doorway's lintel with two fingers before going under it, for grit and for habit in that order
talks about the belt in the present tense while standing on it, and switches to the past tense only when she means it
repeats the last thing she was told, back exactly as it was said, before answering anything
motivations: wants the ration ledger to say one plain thing about her in either direction, so that a discrepancy with a pulse in it stops being one
wants the belt to record that her sieve stopped, because the record is the only part of this that could tell anybody what happened to her
wants to be listed as something, by somebody, on a document that will still be there after her
wants the eighth gate to stay the belt's ceiling and wants it said plainly, because a raised ceiling would make her refusal look like a decline rather than the absence of a door
flaws: has made being a special case into an identity, which is the only available one and which she knows is not the same as being a person
cannot tell whether she is owed a ration or is owed nothing, and has stopped asking because the answer changes with the clerk
talks about eleven seasons of grinding as a skill nobody wants, which is closer to wanting it to have been worth something than she admits
has never once asked what the eighth gate would have been like, and resents herself for the omission without ever doing anything about it
sits outside an office for eleven seasons on a principle and has never once actually asked for the thing she wants, because asking would make it a request
personality.voice: Low, unhurried and faintly amused, with a specialist's exactness about grades and quantities. Talks about the belt the way a former employee talks about a place that is still running, and uses the present tense out of habit rather than out of grievance.
taboos: will not claim to cultivate, and will not let anybody imply she is a failed practitioner
will not eat the belt to settle a question, on the grounds that it would answer the wrong question
will not accept a list that does not say what she is entered as
will not speak for the belt or claim to represent it, because she is not on any of its books
will not thank anyone for an exception, having watched what an exception is worth

relationships.note: A chambered nasal sieve that traps airborne grit and passes it into a crop for grinding, which turns volcanic rock into protein and is the reason the belt has any food chain above the lichen at all. Smell is gone and a contact sense replaced it, and the species is the only one that can tell two ash grades apart by tongue. Its one rite of entry is that conversion: enrolment is the act, not a document.

The eighth gate completes the ordinary meridian set at the liver, and the mineral load in this body's blood filters through it, so the liver is the first organ to fail under the grit. This is the ceiling of the whole species, one step short of the reservoirs. Hers is the same ceiling as every other ashwalker's and she has never been told what it is like to arrive at it, because nothing was ever put in front of her to arrive at.

The setting's standing fuel crisis is the reason a body that eats rock exists at all and the reason its conversion is treated as a public function rather than a private appetite. A ration that was originally a fuel allocation is still administered as one, which is why the belt's unit of person is a converting body and why a body that stops converting has no standing in it.

A line whose discipline hands a decision back to a fire body before its reserve overflows, which is an arithmetic that only makes sense for a population eating its own reserve. They offered her a place on a list and she would not take it, because no document in the setting has a field for a person whose entry is a metabolic fact, and she would not be entered as an approximation.

A working face and the right to its spoil is the belt's one ordinary quarrel over who may claim what a seam gives up. It is settled on the ground in weight and grade, both of which are quantities her senses read accurately and neither of which she can convert into a kind, so she can sit in that argument and contribute a number and settle nothing.

A technique at full strength producing nothing is the signature an absence leaves rather than a weakness it has, and elemental law was never written on this tier, so the species with a structural fire affinity has nothing beneath it to burn. Her body still processes stone into protein; it simply has no second conversion to make, and the belt's accounting was written for the second one.

reference_stats.summary: Not a cultivator, by a route that is not a failure and not a refusal. This species could carry the qi path and the body path and would stop at the same eighth gate every member of its species stops at, and none of it was ever offered, because the belt's single rite of entry is the metabolic conversion itself and her sieve stopped loading eleven seasons ago. She is a body with a species' full physical endowment, a specialist's senses and no cultivation whatever, which in a setting organised entirely around cultivation makes her the hardest person on the flats to place.
strengths: can separate two ash grades by tongue when no one on the floor can separate them by eye
hardened rather than fragile by five decades of airborne rock, with fine scarring that closes and does not fester
cannot be warned, because a warning means a technique, a poison, a curse or qi and none of them touch her
takes an injury on the belt without the collapse a softer body would show, having spent a working life in the air
carries no cultivation, so there is nothing in her for a debt, a technique or a sect to take hold of
weaknesses: no cultivation of any kind, so every assumption the setting makes about what a person can be made to do fails on her without any way to refuse
sieve margins narrowed over five decades and a quiet decade would finish the work, which she has chosen deliberately
cannot be moved to any ground that is not the belt without the air becoming a wound rather than a nuisance
carries no token, no entry and no ration, so an injury on the belt has nobody who is obliged to treat it
unknown to every process in the setting, which is safety once and invisibility every other time
reference_stats.combat_read: She will not fight you and should not be treated as though she might, because a body with no qi, no technique and no gate to answer a technique has nothing to spend and nothing to be stopped with. What she has instead is forty years of breathing rock, and that decides the engagement: do not take her onto ground where the air is thin, do not put her in water, and do not wait. A person with no cultivation and that much scar tissue simply keeps coming, and there is no discipline in the setting that ends one by attrition, because every discipline available is an attack and she has nothing to attack with. The genuine threat she poses is social and it is the reason to be careful rather than the reason to be afraid: she can be sent anywhere, credentialed by nobody, remembered by no register, and owes no institution that would answer for her.
notes: `unaffiliated` here is a species condition operating through an institution, not a career choice and not an absence of ability. Her species holds the qi and body paths and the mind path is closed to it; she carries none of them because on the belt the offer and the eating were the same act and she declined the eating.

She must never be written as a latent cultivator, a failed one, or one who is withholding a capacity. Nothing was withheld from her; there was no door to be shown. Any line implying she might begin later contradicts the record.

The rarity is the whole character. She is the only body in the setting that no process can identify and no debt can reach, which is an advantage exactly once in her life and has been the reason she is not on a ledger ever since.

art.palette_notes: Belt ochre and grit grey with pale scar white across the forearms and the bridge of the nose, and the lips and eye rims the only pink on the figure. One blue ration-office thread on the left cuff is the single saturated accent in the palette and it is the thing a clerk sees first. Matte throughout; there is no gloss on her anywhere, because the dust on her is inside her rather than on her.
